📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough The changes add early context cancellation checks to eleven FilerStoreWrapper methods, causing them to return cancellation errors immediately when the context is already cancelled. Comprehensive table-driven tests verify this behavior for both regular operations and transaction control methods. ## Changes | Cohort / File(s) | Summary | |---|---| | **Implementation**
`weed/filer/filerstore_wrapper.go` | Added upfront `ctx.Err()` checks to 11 methods (`InsertEntry`, `InsertEntryKnownAbsent`, `UpdateEntry`, `DeleteEntry`, `DeleteOneEntry`, `DeleteFolderChildren`, `BeginTransaction`, `CommitTransaction`, `RollbackTransaction`, `KvPut`, `KvDelete`) that immediately return context cancellation errors without proceeding to underlying operations. | | **Testing**
`weed/filer/filerstore_wrapper_test.go` | Added two new test functions with table-driven subtests: `TestFilerStoreWrapperContextCancellation` verifying write operations return cancellation errors and read operations succeed, and `TestFilerStoreWrapperTransactionContextCancellation` verifying transaction methods return cancellation errors when context is cancelled. | ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~12 minutes ## Poem > 🐰 *A hop, a skip, a swift retreat—* > *When context calls "STOP!", no beat to beat,* > *Eleven methods now check twice,* > *Before proceeding—oh, how nice!* > *Tests aplenty, all in place,* > *Cancellations caught at a rabbit's pace!* 🎯
🚥 Pre-merge checks | ✅ 2 | ❌ 1 ### ❌ Failed checks (1 warning) | Check name | Status | Explanation | Resolution | | :----------------: | :--------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Docstring Coverage | ⚠️ Warning | Docstring coverage is 66.67% which is insufficient. The required threshold is 80.00%. | Write docstrings for the functions missing them to satisfy the coverage threshold. |
✅ Passed checks (2 passed) | Check name | Status | Explanation | | :---------------: | :------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Title check | ✅ Passed | The title clearly summarizes the main fix: adding pre-cancellation checks to prevent orphaned metadata in S3 operations, directly matching the primary change in the changeset. | | Description check | ✅ Passed | The description covers all key template sections: problem statement (data corruption issue and regression), solution approach (pre-cancellation checks), testing (comprehensive test coverage added), and completes most checklist items. |
✏️ Tip: You can configure your own custom pre-merge checks in the settings.
✨ Finishing Touches
🧪 Generate unit tests (beta) - [ ] Create PR with unit tests

# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues
